blocks.text: SAN FERNANDO, Bukidnon — In a landmark breakthrough for Mindanao’s marginalized hinterlands, the Philippine Health Insurance Corp. (PhilHealth) has officially launched a historic push to secure 100 percent universal health insurance coverage for 18,332 Indigenous Peoples (IPs) across this municipality, the first in Northern Mindanao (Region 10). The pioneering Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) was formally signed on November 17, 2026, at the Flor De Vista Resort in Barangay Namnam—located some 16 kilometers away from the municipal government center.
